summary: The audit checks six quarters of ARTSTUDI 342 tutorials, four each of the ARTSTUDI 342A and 342B seminars and two of 342C (letter graded), and 48 units taken at Stanford. You move in the three DGS-approved 4-unit electives from year one; at least one must be in Art History, Film and Media Studies, or art theory and criticism, which the audit checks for ARTHIST and FILMEDIA courses. The 3.0 GPA each quarter (with a B or better, or S, expected in every required course), the summer plan, the four faculty reviews, six quarters of teaching and the thesis are checked by hand.

freeform-text.why: "Of the three electives taken during the first year, at least one must be selected from Art History (ARTHIST), Film and Media Studies (FILMEDIA), or Art Theory & Criticism. Students are expected to consult first with Art History faculty and obtain approval from the Director of Graduate Studies (DGS) before enrolling". One of the three year-one electives (rule ov-artpmfa-electives), so it shares. Art Theory & Criticism has no subject code; such a course is moved in by hand.
